notes:
ACCESS: Direct HTTP (curl and WebFetch) to elcorteingles.es (including /robots.txt) returned Akamai edge 'Access Denied' 403 on every request. Playwright/CDP (headless Chromium, real UA, es-ES locale, anti-automation flag disabled) hit the identical 403 at the edge before any page JS ran - same block, not a JS challenge. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3, last resort) which used the real logged-in Chrome session and loaded pages normally, so all findings below came from that tier. No robots.txt content was ever retrievable (itself edge-blocked), so no Claude-specific disallow was found; this was an IP/fingerprint block, not a policy opt-out.

SCOPE: Investigated the Hogar (Home) department only, per instructions. Today is 2026-09-04; the site is mid 'Final de Verano' (end-of-summer) and 'Vuelta al Cole' (back-to-school) promos, so several holidays are visibly off-season on the live site.

NAVIDAD (Christmas): A real Home taxonomy exists - breadcrumb Hogar > Navidad at /hogar/navidad/ ('Decoración Navideña'), with sub-pages /hogar/navidad/luces-de-navidad/ (Luces de Navidad), /hogar/navidad/belenes/ (Belenes) and /hogar/navidad/espumillones-y-cintas/ (Espumillones y cintas). All were checked (screenshots + read_page + get_page_text): every one of them is a pure evergreen SEO/editorial template (hero image + long marketing copy) with NO product grid, NO 'Categorías/Ordenar y filtrar' toolbar and NO 'X productos' count - unlike genuine live PLPs on this same site (e.g. /hogar/decoracion/ shows 'Decoración | 1804 productos' immediately). A site search for 'arbol de navidad' does return 295 cross-department results, proving Christmas SKUs exist in inventory, but the site's own curated Home/Navidad category pages are not yet merchandised for the 2026 season (no exact site-reported qty available) - so no genuine Christmas PLP rows are included. Excluded per the no-storewide-sale / no-uncounted-content rule.

REYES MAGOS (Three Kings Day/Epiphany): /hogar/reyes/ and the top-level /reyes/ both redirect to generic hub/home pages with no Reyes-specific content. Absent.

HALLOWEEN: /hogar/halloween/ redirects away (no such Home-scoped route), but the top-level hub /halloween/ is live (titled 'Halloween 2025' - stale copy, not yet refreshed for 2026, but functioning) and its own 'Categorías' list includes a 'Decoración' entry linking to /halloween/decoracion-de-halloween/, a genuine live PLP: 'Decoración de Halloween | 62 productos'. It splits into two site-defined sub-filters: 'Mesa' (/halloween/decoracion-de-halloween/mesa/, 20 productos) and 'Decoración y velas' (/halloween/decoracion-de-halloween/decoracion-y-velas/, 32 productos). Sampled per rules: Mesa's items are genuinely Halloween-themed (Le Creuset pumpkin-shaped cast-iron cocotte, pumpkin butter dish, mini pumpkin cocotte, 'Set de 4 bandejas para Halloween', jack-o'-lantern mug, ghost-shaped melamine bowl) - kept as valid. 'Decoración y velas' sampled items were generic, non-Halloween home goods (a red-berry scented candle, plain white pillar candle, 'Murray Iron Console Table', 'Ginger Room Policemento Side Table', 'Leo Room Polycot Side Table') with zero pumpkin/ghost/witch/bat theming in the sample - flagged as likely miscategorized generic decor riding the Halloween URL, not a genuine seasonal collection. The parent total (62) does not equal the sum of the two children (20+32=52), so ~10 products are ungrouped at the parent level; parent kept as an is_group row for context.

SAN VALENTIN: /san-valentin/ is live (titled 'Regalos para San Valentín 2026') but is the same generic-hub template as Navidad/Reyes - a row of department buttons (incl. HOGAR, which just links to the generic /hogar/ home page) plus SEO copy. No dedicated, counted Home PLP. Absent.

DIA DE LA MADRE / DIA DEL PADRE (Mother's/Father's Day - explicitly in-scope per task rules but content-verified, not assumed): /dia-de-la-madre/ is live ('Regalos · Día de la Madre') with the identical generic department-button + editorial-copy template as San Valentín/Navidad; its Hogar section is prose only ('desde muebles y decoración... hasta colchones y almohadas'), no linked, counted Home PLP. Día del Padre was not separately fetched given the fully consistent pattern across every other off-season hub on this site, but is inferred absent on the same basis.

DIWALI / THANKSGIVING / NEW YEAR: No trace of these in Spanish site navigation, hub URLs, or category menus (expected - not observed Spanish retail holidays); not applicable to elcorteingles.es.

CONCLUSION: One genuine, currently live, exact-qty Home seasonal category found (Halloween tableware), plus its (partially contaminated) parent kept for context and its rejected sibling kept flagged for review. Christmas taxonomy exists but is unpopulated pre-season and excluded. All other checked holidays are absent from the Home department at this time. ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): removed the 'Decoration and Candles' row (32 items, https://www.elcorteingles.es/halloween/decoracion-de-halloween/decoracion-y-velas/) - sampled products were generic non-holiday home goods (scented candle, plain pillar candle, side tables/console table) with no pumpkin/ghost/witch/bat theming despite the Halloween URL path, matching the generic-catalog-mislabeled-as-holiday pattern.
